actionable_steps.step: Practice the Hamsa Gayatri in your breathing: with 'So' (inhalation) welcome God into you, with 'Ham' (exhalation) drive ego out — 21,600 times a day.
Overcome ego through love, peace, humility, and courage.

actionable_steps.citation: Bhagawan deplores devotees' lapses — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-03
actionable_steps.step: Think always: 'I am just a puppet in the hands of God; everything is His play.'

actionable_steps.citation: The Universe - the Guru — SSS Vol 15 (1981 - 82), 1981-07-17
actionable_steps.step: Enquire 'Who am I?' and find that everyone is I — do not let the ego express itself, for it smothers the spring of love.

actionable_steps.citation: The sun at your doorstep — SSS Vol 5 (1965)
actionable_steps.step: Develop wisdom and discrimination instead of fighting the ego directly — like the tadpole's tail, it will fall away on its own.

actionable_steps.citation: Faith In God Removes All Fears — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-29
actionable_steps.step: Destroy the walls of ego and attachment around your heart — God will enter on His own; you need not even call.

definition.citation: Devotion Is The Panacea — SSS Vol 21 (1988), 1988-09-15
definition.quote: The man who is wrapped up in his ego cannot recognise God. When ego goes, God appears. When the ego merges in the Atma, there is mukti (liberation). It is ego that is the cause of man's bondage.

discourses.citation: Realize God Through Experience — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-08
discourses.quote: Our body also is like a football... How long will they hit? As long as there is air of ego in it. The moment the air of ego is gone, they will stop hitting it. So, ego is responsible for all problems.
As long there is ego in you, you will never be happy. No doubt, Emperor Bali was a great devotee, but he was also egotistic. Ego is a bad quality for a devotee.

discourses.citation: Give Up Ego And Attachment To Become Great — SSS Vol 40 (2007), 2007-02-17
discourses.quote: It is only because of ego and attachment that a person is spoiled. One can become really great when he sheds these two.

discourses.citation: Realise the Oneness of the Atmic Principle — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-28
discourses.quote: If you leave ego, you become dear to all... Whichever way you look at, ego is the result of delusion and ignorance.

make_it_real: Every breath can be a choice: breathe God in, breathe ego out.
title: Ego

vahinis.quote: Just as the healthy glow of the body is hidden from sight by the clothes that cover it, so the individual soul obscured by egotism (ahamkara) is not able to reveal the splendour of the true knowledge of Brahman (Brahmathathwa), which is its treasured possession. For egotism is at the root of all evil, all defects, all deficiencies.
